pages.text: Four bosses spawn in the world as structures. Explore to find them — they don't announce themselves.$(br2)$(bold)Dragon$() — Fire attacks, flying. Drops Dragon Armor pieces (Netherite-tier, built-in fire resistance). May need multiple kills for full set.

$(bold)Yeti$() — Ice and knockback attacks. Drops Yeti Armor and ice-themed weapons.$(br2)$(bold)Sand Worm$() — Emerges from desert biomes, poison attacks. Drops unique weapons and Sand Worm Armor.$(br2)$(bold)Knight$() — Melee-heavy, high defense. Drops Knight Armor set.

$(bold)Tips:$() Use Epic Fight battle mode for all of these — vanilla combat won't cut it at this tier. Holy spells (Iron's Spellbooks) make a big difference for sustain during long fights. Bring backup gear — these hits are heavy.$(br2)Drops are not guaranteed per kill. Plan for multiple runs.
